_help: Lettering for the card front (engraved). Each line is centred; width_mm is the inked width of the line; top_mm is the y of the line's top edge from the top of the card, or null to place it just below the previous line. Delete all lines for no text. font is a Fontsource name (npm package @fontsource/<font>); weight 400 unless the font offers others.
